architecture.name: spinalflow
architecture.buffer_note: Psum/vmem sizes preserve the N=128 reference allocation, not a computed requirement; per-tile psum need is 2*min(N,COUT) bytes. nocsim does not enforce capacities.

excluded_layers.layer_01_layer1_0_conv1: kernel 3x3, stride 2: the arch models replay only 3x3 stride-1 convs
excluded_layers.layer_03_layer1_0_shortcut_0: kernel 1x1, stride 2: the arch models replay only 3x3 stride-1 convs
excluded_layers.layer_08_layer2_0_conv1: kernel 3x3, stride 2: the arch models replay only 3x3 stride-1 convs
excluded_layers.layer_10_layer2_0_shortcut_0: kernel 1x1, stride 2: the arch models replay only 3x3 stride-1 convs
excluded_layers.layer_15_layer3_0_conv1: kernel 3x3, stride 2: the arch models replay only 3x3 stride-1 convs
excluded_layers.layer_17_layer3_0_shortcut_0: kernel 1x1, stride 2: the arch models replay only 3x3 stride-1 convs

metric: For each network/N/sample, sum included layer total_cycles and count_cycles separately; memory_cycles is their difference. Layers execute sequentially without overlap.
coverage: VGG16 includes all 12 captured convolutions. ResNet19 is a 13-of-19-convolution partial sum: 01,03,08,10,15,17 are omitted because stride-2 replay is unsupported. These are the spatial-downsampling convolutions, so omission is not uniform across network depth. Uncaptured operations are outside the metric.

feasibility.reference: Raw [T,C,H,W] sample, pad=(kernel-1)//2; count_nonzero of each kernel-by-kernel window beginning at (ho*stride, wo*stride) in padded input. No generator window function is used.

cases.public_loader_exclusion: kernel 3x3, stride 2: the arch models replay only 3x3 stride-1 convs
kernel 1x1, stride 2: the arch models replay only 3x3 stride-1 convs

figure.boxes: Q1-Q3 of five per-sample network totals; median center; min-max whiskers; linear NumPy percentile interpolation

limitations: Five captured samples per network; no confidence intervals.
ResNet19 coverage is a 13-of-19 partial convolution sum with nonuniform omission of spatial-downsampling layers.
Network sums assume sequential execution with no inter-layer overlap.
Manual mappings; no solver optimization or buffer-capacity enforcement.
Lanes above a layer's COUT remain idle; fixed bandwidth and replay model determine latency.
